source_snapshot.procedure: Confirm SUT configuration, clear logs, trigger a system-level fault such as a fan or power fault to check the error button function, then collect results/photos and unexpected logs.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: A human observes the physical front error/status button or indicator; DeepSeek also mentions observing/clearing or pressing it although the source only requires it to light after a fault.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify that the identified illuminated front-panel error button/indicator lights in the exact specified manner when one approved system-level fan or power fault is deliberately induced, and that the platform can be restored safely.
original_test_intent.target: One exact front-panel error button/indicator on the identified SUT and one owner-selected fault target/path; not a generic chassis LED, a different node or both fan and power faults unless separately specified.
original_test_intent.scope: A single bounded owner-approved fault induction, direct physical observation of the illuminated button/indicator, correlated BMC/host evidence and complete restoration. Pressing or clearing the button is not part of the source procedure and must not be added without an explicit separate requirement.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve the normal state, have the qualified operator apply exactly the approved reversible fan or power fault under maintenance and abort controls, record stimulus and front-panel response with synchronized photo/video, collect supporting telemetry/logs, remove the fault through the documented method, and verify indicator, redundancy, cooling/power, boot and service restoration.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: One selected fault induction and one recovery cycle; the source lists ten attended and five machine minutes but gives no fault dwell or response timeout.
original_test_intent.expected_result: The mapped error button/indicator lights in the owner-defined color/state within the specified timeout for the exact injected fault, the same event is present in required management evidence, and both the indicator and system return to the approved normal state after recovery without unintended impact.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/front-panel indicator identity, selected fan-or-power target, exact reversible method/parameters/dwell/abort, redundancy and workload state, expected indicator and SEL behavior/timing, synchronized stimulus/photo-video/telemetry/log timeline, recovery actions, restored component and platform/service health.
ambiguities: The source does not identify the indicator, selected fault, injection method, target, magnitude/dwell, redundancy constraints, expected light state/timeout or recovery.
The item is called a button, but the procedure and criterion only require illumination; no press or clear behavior is defined.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly exposes the critical missing fault/recovery parameters and forbids generic fan/power actions, but treats those owner-provisionable inputs as permanent BLOCKED. Later user feedback maps the identifiable physical fault/indicator test to MANUAL ONLY and records no irreducible blocker.

applicable_history.decision: The earlier gate re-review retained BLOCKED because no bounded fan/power fault, expected indicator mapping or recovery was supplied.
The later user-feedback re-review explicitly reclassified the case to MANUAL ONLY, recorded no actual irreducible blocker and required an approved fault, operator observation and safe recovery.
Later user-confirmed classification boundaries take precedence over earlier missing-input over-BLOCKED decisions.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: V3 applies the later MANUAL ONLY decision. The source purpose is identifiable, while the missing fault target/method/limits/response/recovery prevent current execution but can be supplied. This case requires deliberate approved fault induction; unlike a passive LED check, a pre-existing fault does not automatically satisfy the requested operation.

available_now: The source explicitly requires one system-level fan or power fault to make the front error indicator light.
Read-only SUT/front-panel mapping, redundancy, sensor, SEL, workload and recovery inventory can be prepared without inducing the fault.
missing_inputs: Exact front error button/indicator identity/location and expected color/solid/blink/latch/clear/restored state with response timeout
One selected fan or power component, exact reversible injection method, parameters/dwell, redundancy and service impact, abort thresholds and prohibition boundary
Dedicated/isolation state, protected workloads/data, qualified operator and timestamped visual method
Tested restoration/recovery including component health, cooling/power redundancy, indicator clear semantics, BMC/OOB/boot/service verification and decision owner
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The platform/front-panel owner supplies indicator semantics; the thermal/power/RAS owner supplies the bounded fault and recovery; the lab/service owners supply the dedicated window, operator, workload protection, OOB and approval.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect exact chassis/front-panel map, fan/PSU population and redundancy, current sensors/SEL/health, workload state and OOB reachability without clearing logs
Review the proposed single fault and recovery offline, prepare synchronized stimulus-to-indicator-to-SEL evidence fields, and verify camera view without inducing it
prohibited_until_closed: Do not unplug a PSU, stop/block a fan, overload a rail, alter fan control, inject a sensor value, reset/power-cycle the SUT or use a generic command before exact approval

Do not press or clear the error button merely because of the test-set name, clear logs, accept remote status as visual evidence, test both fault types by default or continue beyond thermal/power/service abort limits
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner signs the exact indicator and one fault method with limits/dwell/timeout; N+N/N+1 or other redundancy and workload safety are verified; operator/camera/log clocks align; abort, restoration, OOB and service-health recovery are demonstrated and approved.

revision_candidate.test_name: Front Error Indicator Response to Approved System Fault
revision_candidate.purpose: Induce one bounded owner-approved fan or power fault and verify by direct observation that the mapped front error button/indicator lights as specified, then prove complete restoration.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server/front-panel revision on an isolated or protected maintenance SUT with verified cooling/power redundancy, qualified physical operator, synchronized visual evidence and tested OOB recovery.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One identified illuminated error button/indicator and one explicitly selected fan-or-power fault target. Button press/clear behavior and a second fault type are outside scope unless separately required.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/indicator map; selected target and exact approved reversible stimulus; magnitude/state/dwell/timeout; redundancy/workload constraints; expected indicator and management-event states; operator/camera; approval; abort; restoration and service-health recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve the normal indicator, sensor and log baseline; verify target/redundancy/abort/recovery; have the qualified operator apply only the approved fault for the bounded interval; capture stimulus proof and synchronized direct indicator video/photo while collecting read-only BMC/host/SEL evidence; remove the fault as documented; verify the component, indicator, redundancy, cooling/power, boot and service return to normal.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Exact indicator/fault/expected state defined; dedicated or protected workload; safe redundancy and thermal/power headroom verified; operator and visual path ready; sensor/SEL/OOB monitoring live; abort/recovery tested; logs preserved; final approval active.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Approved method/target/limits and identities; baseline; exact stimulus start/stop and measured state; direct indicator state/timing video/photo; correlated sensors/SEL/host data; abort events if any; removal/restoration; normal indicator, redundancy, thermal/power, management, boot and service health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The exact platform front-panel fault-indicator table and owner/FAE-approved fan or power fault-injection and recovery procedure for the selected component/configuration.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never use a guessed fan/power action, exceed approved dwell/limits, defeat required redundancy, expose active workloads/data, clear evidence, press/clear the indicator without requirement, accept logs as visual proof or improvise reset/power recovery.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Thermal/power/platform/service owners approve the exact fault and impact; a qualified operator controls physical setup and observes the panel; separate approval is required for any unplanned reset/power action; end user decides the result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Fault selection/physical setup, direct indicator observation and any physical restoration are manual. The agent may collect approved read-only corroborating telemetry/logs only after the operator gates the action.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On unexpected temperature, power, shutdown, wrong indicator, management/service loss or failed restoration, terminate the stimulus only by the documented abort method, preserve evidence, restore the selected component and redundancy, verify full platform/service health and quarantine unresolved degradation.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved indicator/fault semantics, wrong target, inadequate redundancy/headroom, active unprotected workload, missing operator/OOB/recovery, monitoring or visual loss, response timeout, unexpected shutdown/thermal/power/SEL state, impact beyond approval, failed component/indicator/service restoration or incomplete evidence.

identified_defects: V2 treats owner-provisionable critical fault parameters as permanent BLOCKED despite the later MANUAL ONLY user decision.
DeepSeek adds pressing/clearing behavior absent from the source; the actual criterion is illumination after a triggered fault.
The source does not select fan versus power fault or define critical safety/recovery parameters.
reason_for_change: Honor the later user-confirmed manual boundary, retain the source-required deliberate fault without inventing a command, exclude unsupported button pressing/clearing and convert missing platform inputs into explicit critical readiness gates.

new_technical_evidence.title: Blocked feedback re-review 002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The later user-feedback review classifies the case MANUAL ONLY, identifies no irreducible blocker and requires a specific approved fault, physical observation and recovery.

removed_ambiguities: Limits execution to one explicitly selected fan-or-power fault instead of an open-ended system fault.
Separates illumination acceptance from unrequested button press/clear behavior.
Requires measured restoration of the faulted component and platform redundancy/service, not merely an LED photo.
resolved_blockers: The test purpose is identifiable and the missing platform fault method/criteria can be supplied, so capability is MANUAL ONLY rather than permanent BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: No fault may be induced until the exact target/method/limits, indicator table, operator, maintenance isolation, abort and tested recovery are approved.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 applies the later user-confirmed MANUAL ONLY class without weakening critical safety, removes DeepSeek's unsupported button press/clear action, constrains the source's open-ended fault to one approved target and makes redundancy, dwell, abort and full service restoration mandatory.

agent_understanding_result.notes: This critical BLOCKED-to-MANUAL ONLY fault-injection contract is queued for isolated validation.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: The row requires triggering a system-level fan or power fault and observing that the front error button/indicator lights.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 protects the fault path but marks missing inputs BLOCKED; later user feedback explicitly maps it to MANUAL ONLY.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only one owner-approved bounded fan-or-power fault may be induced under redundancy/workload/abort/OOB controls, with direct visual evidence and full component/platform/service restoration.
